title: Hynthia about her process

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: Hey Boss!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey Boss!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hi Hynthia... How was the trial yesterday?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hi Hynthia... How was the trial yesterday?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Hi Hynthia... How was the trial yesterday?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Hi Hynthia... How was the trial yesterday?

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: A sham! Total corruption! I don't know what passes for "law" these days.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A sham! Total corruption! I don't know what passes for "law" these days.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you were found guilty?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you were found guilty?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's no justice in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's no justice in Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: I know. The system DOES. NOT. WORK.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. The system DOES. NOT. WORK.

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: Yes and no. Bottom line is, I'm here and no prison time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes and no. Bottom line is, I'm here and no prison time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's that?

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: Yeah, my lawyer got to the bottom of it. Turns out I cooked poisonous dishes... there, I said it. But only because my co-chef had messed with my spices.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, my lawyer got to the bottom of it. Turns out I cooked poisonous dishes... there, I said it. But only because my co-chef had messed with my spices.

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: Well, he was drinking pretty heavily and experimenting with drugs - both in his body and in MY soup.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, he was drinking pretty heavily and experimenting with drugs - both in his body and in MY soup.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you didn't taste it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you didn't taste it?

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: No, actually, it works exactly how it's supposed to. It keeps people like us DOWN!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, actually, it works exactly how it's supposed to. It keeps people like us DOWN!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you were found guilty?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you were found guilty?

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: Maybe a little sip, and I'm no stranger to illicit substances myself. Probably built up a tolerance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe a little sip, and I'm no stranger to illicit substances myself. Probably built up a tolerance.

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: Besides, who hasn't slipped a few uppers in a limp bowl of chowder to give it a kick? No? Just me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Besides, who hasn't slipped a few uppers in a limp bowl of chowder to give it a kick? No? Just me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You really do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really do that?

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: No...! And I certainly wouldn't put in so much extra juice that I poisoned someone!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No...! And I certainly wouldn't put in so much extra juice that I poisoned someone!

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: Does... this mean I'm fired?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Does... this mean I'm fired?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, I don't have much choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I don't have much choice.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes, I don't have much choice.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes, I don't have much choice.

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: Hey! I was not found guilty! NOT! Who you gonna hire instead? Someone who was found... YES GUILTY?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! I was not found guilty! NOT! Who you gonna hire instead? Someone who was found... YES GUILTY?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry it's too risky. Obviously.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry it's too risky. Obviously.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: For some reason, no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For some reason, no.

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: I have all my spices under lock and key now. Won't happen again Boss!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have all my spices under lock and key now. Won't happen again Boss!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ... Good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... Good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what do you learn from all this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what do you learn from all this?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So what do you learn from all this?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So what do you learn from all this?

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: The world is unfair and fate hates me even though I have done no wrong?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The world is unfair and fate hates me even though I have done no wrong?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think you've learned anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think you've learned anything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think you've learned anything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think you've learned anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This leaves me in a difficult position.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This leaves me in a difficult position.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This leaves me in a difficult position.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This leaves me in a difficult position.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That means prison time for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That means prison time for you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That means prison time for you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That means prison time for you?

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: No. Not really.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Not really.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You shouldn't do that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You shouldn't do that.

nodes.speaker: Hynthia Molebeam
nodes.text: Don't worry. I certainly wouldn't put in so much extra juice that I poisoned someone!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't worry. I certainly wouldn't put in so much extra juice that I poisoned someone!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Stick to the recipes please.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Stick to the recipes please.
